items.title: eMudhra Intermediate CA Compromise
items.title_zh: eMudhra 八个中间 CA 私钥泄露，全球信任库被迫紧急更新
items.title_en: Eight eMudhra intermediate CA private keys compromised, forcing global trust-store updates
items.summary: Eight eMudhra intermediate CA private keys were compromised, forcing urgent trust-store and ca-certificates updates across Linux distros and language ecosystems like Python's pip, uv, and certifi.

items.title: DeepInfer: High-performance inference framework for DeepSeek models
items.title_zh: DeepSeek 开源 DeepInfer 模型推理框架
items.title_en: DeepSeek open-sources DeepInfer inference framework for its models
items.summary: DeepSeek released DeepInfer, a high-performance inference framework for its models, sparking large HN discussion about open-weight AI, throughput claims, and US-China AI competition.

items.title: Voxtral 3
items.title_zh: Mistral 发布 Voxtral 3 语音智能体 SDK 与语音模型
items.title_en: Mistral Launches Voxtral 3 Voice Agent SDK and Speech Models
items.summary: Mistral announces Voxtral 3, a new speech/voice-agent model and SDK, prompting substantive HN discussion about real-world transcription quality and deployment.

items.title: Google open-sources TorchTPU, a native PyTorch back end for TPUs
items.title_zh: 谷歌开源 TorchTPU，为 TPU 提供原生 PyTorch 后端
items.title_en: Google open-sources TorchTPU, a native PyTorch backend for TPUs
items.summary: Google open-sourced TorchTPU, a native PyTorch backend for TPUs, giving ML developers first-party PyTorch support on Google's accelerators.

items.title: Tsrs: A Port of TypeScript to Rust
items.title_zh: Cloudflare 与 VoidZero 将 TypeScript 编译器移植到 Rust，推出 tsrs 项目
items.title_en: Cloudflare and VoidZero Port the TypeScript Compiler to Rust as tsrs
items.summary: Cloudflare's tsrs project ports the TypeScript compiler to Rust, achieving speedups partly via a novel arena-based memory model, driven originally by the need for a compiler that runs in a WASM-only sandbox.
